read.title: Image Checklist for the New Serum Listing
read.text:
Before we upload the new serum listing, please check the images against this list.

The main image must have a pure white background and show only the product, with no text, logos, or props. The product should fill most of the frame. All files need a resolution of at least 2,000 pixels on the longest side so that the zoom function works.

For the other six slots, use a mix of images: one lifestyle image, one image that explains the key ingredients, one that shows how to use the product, and one size comparison. Short text is allowed on these images, but keep it large enough to read on a phone.

Images that do not comply with these rules may be removed, and the listing can be hidden from search.

write.en: Ask a designer for images for a new sunscreen listing: a main image on a white background, one lifestyle image, and high-resolution files.
write.model:
Hi Sarah,

Could you prepare the images for our new sunscreen listing by Thursday? The main image needs a pure white background and should show only the product so that it will comply with Amazon's rules. We also need one lifestyle image of someone using it at the beach to help the listing stand out. Please send all files in high resolution.

Thanks,
Minsu
